impact.deployment_impact: Ten existing collector uploads, up to 20 builds/30 deployment records including one bounded recovery per service; no schedules/budgets/concurrency changes. Yuyu max work reduced to eight per invocation. SNKRDUNK persistent pause remains set.

recovery.procedure: Upload retained exact prior source only to affected existing staging collectors; API restore prior compatible source 65ff5fd1a35803c8161c4f38d3af4f64e30a085e. Preserve source pauses and schedules; prior source remains fail-closed. Do not retry denied source requests.
recovery.trigger: Stop affected path on wrong identity, uncontrolled requests, CRASHED/second failed build, wrong destination/source, or unknown skip. Contain required source denial through existing persistent budget pause.
recovery.backup: No migration, history mutation or mapping update; retained source archive verified. Existing raw evidence and append-only telemetry retained.

post_change: Structured paired run revision, claim/reservation settlement and current pause evidence
verification.observation_window: One subsequent normal scheduled cycle per collector, then ongoing operation until mission success or demonstrated source/evidence constraint. No blind unpause, no PSA10.
